tvShows.name: FIR
tvShows.description: F.I.R. presents to you a female inspector and her funny sub-inspector, trying to solve cases. Their sincere attempts to crack the mysteries are hilarious and worth a hearty laugh. The sitcom is set in a Police Station where constables indulge in amazing antics. A space you must visit to experience an amusing and entertaining comedy.
